notes: A big update: please install it. Editing PDFs had bugs, and this release fixes them: the app no longer closes on PDFs whose pages are forms (syllabus and office-system PDFs); equations are edited in an equation editor (powers, fractions, roots, Greek) with x² and x₂ buttons; text in tables, lists in cells and LaTeX formula tables edit without moving rows apart or spoiling the formulas beside them.
